intro: Explore active wildfire reports across Canada. Select markers on the map to track individual fires here.
filterHelp: Choose one or more regions to update the map and statistics.
clickMarker: Click a marker to add or remove a fire
noneHelp: Select a wildfire marker on the map to see its details. You can track multiple fires at once.
footer: Unofficial data from CWFIS (Natural Resources Canada). Values may change as agencies update their records. Not for safety or evacuation decisions: follow your provincial wildfire agency and local authorities.
